Now I write on topics I enjoy and that is the best part I like about my job.   Know More @X/IPL The blockbuster trade between MI and PBKS finally happened when  Hardik Pandya and  Arshdeep Singh were swapped. Hardik went to PBKS for Rs. 1.65 crore more than his MI salary of Rs. 16.35 crore while Arshdeep came to MI from PBKS for an unchanged salary of Rs. 18 crore. Amid this trade, it has been reported that Axar Patel is going to give up his DC captaincy. 
 Axar Patel's Report Card as DC Skipper 
 According to TOI , Axar is not happy as DC skipper. They failed to make it to the Playoffs in the last two seasons under him. In IPL 2025, DC came 5th and in IPL 2026, they finished 6th. So maybe even Axar feels that it's time for a change and wants to step down as the leader and let someone else take over. 
 @X/IPL 
 Who Will Replace Axar Patel as DC Skipper? 
 Should Axar step down, who will take his place? The top contenders are KL Rahul and Rishabh Pant. Both have captaincy experience. Another option is Nitish Rana who captained KKR. It may be a new chapter for DC if there is a change in the leadership ahead of IPL 2027. 
 No Decision Yet 
 The management is apparently trying to convince the 32-year-old allrounder to stay, but a final call will be taken after the mini auction on December 16. The deadline to announce retained and released players is November 17. 
 @X/IPL 
 Rohit Sharma to Lead MI in IPL 2027? 
 Meanwhile, with Hardik being traded, Rohit Sharma is a good option to replace him as MI skipper. Rohit was the one Hardik took over from during IPL 2024 but in the three seasons he was at the helm, MI finished last, in the Playoffs and 2nd last. 
 All You Need to Know About the IPL 
 The upcoming edition is the 21st season of the IPL. The inaugural edition was in 2008. RR were the first-ever champions while CSK and MI share the record for most titles won with five apiece. RCB are the defending champions having won the last two editions. DC, PBKS, and LSG are the teams that are yet to win the title.
